name: Harry's Honey Pot
description: In 624 South Darby Road Hermitage, PA, Harry's Honey Pot grows Apples, Pumpkins, Corn, Peppers, and Honey on an independent pumpkin patch. The harvest is typically at its peak in autumn. The season runs through autumn. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Aug – Nov in this growing zone.
